Final research materials accompanying the IEEE Access submission of "Endpoint Definitions and Label Provenance in Honey-Bee Toxicity Benchmarking".

This release extends the historical base commit 27f63e1c3cfc63e95c60f6c3cce3edaec05af623 and supplies the final identifier/source audits, sensitivity analyses, Figure 7 and SI S25-S26 materials. It includes the clarified label-reconstruction description and current main/SI table mapping. Existing primary-analysis algorithms and scientific results are retained. No new training or experimental run was performed for this publication operation.

Download all four Research ZIP attachments and extract them into the same destination. Their 806 files form one Research/ directory. The research contents match the final submission attachments byte for byte; FILE_MANIFEST.json covers 804 files, excluding itself and SHA256SUMS.txt. Verify the download hashes using RESEARCH_ARCHIVE_SHA256SUMS.txt.

Read RELEASE_README.txt for purpose, file sizes, platform, dependencies, installation, commands, expected outputs and the corresponding author's contact. The complete documentation is in Research/README.md and Research/docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md (or README.md and docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md in a repository checkout). Preserve LICENSE and NOTICE.md, including third-party terms.

This is a submission-materials release, not a claim of acceptance, publication or an IEEE reproducibility badge. The four ZIPs remain intended for submission as journal supplementary materials; this GitHub release complements that route.
